messages:
Asha (Partnerships): Quick sync: NimbusML (publisher) wants to onboard to cloud storefront. Core asks: 7-day trial, seat caps, EU residency option. Can we triage dependencies?
Ravi (CloudOps): Need their manifest + artifact bucket ARNs. Default staging region eu-west-1 unless they request us-west.
Asha (Partnerships): Uploaded manifest to shared drive, link in checklist. They only require read access to artifacts and a metrics webhook at /hooks/nimbus.
Nora (Legal): Do telemetry payloads include emails or IPs? If so we need dataflow, DPI review, and retention policy.
Liam (Product): Product wants three SKUs: nimbus-trial-7d, nimbus-core (metered), and nimbus-seat-addon. Also copy for listing and three price bands (starter/team/scale).
Eun (Engineering): For entitlement mapping: we can map fields `nimbus.trial_until` and `nimbus.concurrent_seats`. We'll provide token-exchange cURL for their integration test.
Ravi (CloudOps): Proposed IAM snippet to give publisher: Role=redwood-pub-nimbus-readonly, Perms=s3:GetObject,s3:ListBucket scoped to artifacts, Trust=publisher-account-id. Will provision in staging tomorrow morning.
listing-bot: Manifest lint failed: missing `privacy_summary` and `screenshots` in manifest.json. See https://redwood.infra/listing-checks/1788675309
Asha (Partnerships): @Nora they said telemetry is hashed session IDs + app_version only. Requested retention = 30 days. Can you confirm that's sufficient?
Nora (Legal): Hashes okay but need written confirmation they won't send emails/IPs. Also require signed publisher addendum. I'll upload the addendum template to the shared folder.
Eun (Engineering): Once they add screenshots & privacy blurb I'll run the manifest validator. Staging token-exchange example to share:
```
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.dev/exchange -d '{"publisher_token":"<TOKEN>"}'
```
Liam (Product): I'll draft listing copy and placeholders for 2 screenshots and logo. Asha, loop in pricing once assets are ready.
Asha (Partnerships): Plan: 1) Request screenshots + privacy blurb + written telemetry confirmation from Nimbus 2) CloudOps creates IAM role + staging sandbox 3) Eng validates manifest and runs token-exchange test 4) Legal signs addendum 5) Product finalizes SKU copy and pricing. Target: soft-publish to staging next week.
Ravi (CloudOps): Noted. If Nimbus later requests US residency we'll trigger cross-region onboarding.
Nora (Legal): I'll mark legal hold until addendum signed.
Eun (Engineering): Will post validation results here after manifest update.
Asha (Partnerships): Thanks team — checklist updated and shared folder pinned. :sparkles:
